content.what_it_is: Preprocessed (build/pre) FUNWAVE-TVD MODULE TIDE_MODULE (L63-L864): 'a module to add tide/surge boundary conditions into wave simulation' @L57 (HISTORY 11/26/2019 Fengyan Shi @L60; BSD header L12-L55, FILE mod_subgrid.F not present here — this file's header FILE line @L14 area is the standard license block). USEs PARAM @L64, GLOBAL (grid/state/sponge names L65-L70; myid,ier,npx,npy,PX,PY @L72), INPUT_READ @L71, MPI @L73; IMPLICIT NONE @L74, SAVE @L75. Six subroutines: (1) TIDE_INITIAL (L106-L211) reads from input.txt: WaveMakerPointNum into Iwidth_tide (default 30 @L126), TIDAL_BC_ABS (default .FALSE. @L137), TIDAL_BC_GEN_ABS (default .FALSE. @L148); if either BC flag set, reads TideBcType (default 'CONSTANT' @L164) and dispatches TideBcType(1:4)=='CONS' => Tide_READ_CONSTANT @L178, =='DATA' => Tide_READ_DATA_INIT @L188; allocates the four Mloc x Nloc SPONGE_TIDE_* arrays (L191-L192) and CALLs TIDE_SPONGE @L195; if TIDAL_BC_ABS CALLs REMOVE_SPONGE @L207. (2) TIDE_SPONGE (L214-L267) builds directional relaxation coefficient fields with Iwidth=Iwidth_tide @L221, lim=1.0_SP @L222, R_sp=0.85_SP @L223, A_sp=10.0_SP @L224: e.g. west ri=R_sp**(50*(i+npx*Mglob/px-1)/(Iwidth-1)) @L230 and SPONGE_TIDE_WEST(i,j)=max(A_sp**ri,lim) @L231 (east @L238-L239, south @L247-L248, north @L255-L256), then inverts all four arrays 1.0_SP/array (L260-L263). (3) TIDE_BC (L269-L323) relaxes ETA,U,V toward the current tide values inside Iwidth-wide strips where MASK==1: west I=1,Iwidth (L277-L281) via X=Tide_X+(X-Tide_X)*SPONGE_TIDE_*, east I=Mloc-Iwidth+1,Mloc (L289-L293), south J=1,Iwidth (L300-L305), north J=Nloc-Iwidth+1,Nloc (L312-L317). (4) Tide_READ_CONSTANT (L325-L469) READ_Floats Tide{West,East,South,North}_{ETA,U,V} from input.txt; a missing *_ETA disables that side (e.g. TideWest=.FALSE. @L343) and missing U/V default to ZERO (L353, L363, ...). (5) REMOVE_SPONGE (L472-L526) zeroes Sponge_{west,east,south}_width / Sponge_North_width for each active tide side (L480, L489, L498, L507) and, if all sides are inactive, resets TIDAL_BC_ABS=.FALSE. @L517 — but the guard (L515-L516) tests .NOT.TideEast three times and never TideSouth/TideNorth. (6) Tide_READ_DATA_INIT (L528-L666) reads per-side boundary file names (READ_STRING 'Tide{West,East,South,North}FileName' @L543/L576/L606/L636; missing => side disabled), opens fixed units 201/202/203/204 (L555-L556, L586-L587, L616-L617, L646-L647), reads one header line then the first Time,Eta,U,V record into *_2 variables and copies them to *_1 (e.g. L557-L563). TIDE_DATA (L668-L861) is the per-timestep update: for each active side, when TIME has passed both stored times it shifts *_2 into *_1 and reads records until Time_tide_*_2 >= TIME+DT (READ(Ifile,*,END=120) @L685/L732/L778/L824); then linear time interpolation tmp2=(T2-TIME)/MAX(SMALL,ABS(T2-T1)), tmp1=1.0_SP-tmp2 (L707-L709 etc.) and Tide*_U/V/ETA = *_2*tmp1 + *_1*tmp2 (L714-L716, L760-L762, L806-L808, L852-L854); label 120 CONTINUE @L859 is the shared no-more-data exit.

WRITE(3,'(A80)')'You dont specify TideNorth_V, use default: 0'

unresolved: REMOVE_SPONGE all-sides-inactive guard (L515-L516) tests (.NOT.TideWest).AND.(.NOT.TideEast).AND.(.NOT.TideEast).AND.(.NOT.TideEast) — TideEast is tested three times and TideSouth/TideNorth never, so TIDAL_BC_ABS=.FALSE. @L517 can trigger or fail incorrectly when only south/north differ (cross-line L515-L517)

Log message @L521 in REMOVE_SPONGE reads 'You dont specify TideNorth_V, use default: 0' while the paired stdout message @L520 says 'You specify Tide but no BCs, set tide as false' — copy-paste from Tide_READ_CONSTANT

TIDE_DATA: tmp1/tmp2 are both ZERO whenever TIME <= Time_tide_*_1 (init L698-L699/L745-L746/L791-L792/L837-L838 with guard L701/L748/L794/L840), so Tide*_U/V/ETA @L714-L716 etc. evaluate to zero before the first data time instead of holding the first record — cross-line relation between the zero-init and the interpolation lines
Sponge exponents (L230/L238/L247/L255) use integer arithmetic 50*(...)/(Iwidth-1): the exponent is integer-quantized, and Iwidth=1 would divide by zero — no guard in the file
Shared label 120 @L859 is the END= target of all four sides' READs (L685/L732/L778/L824): EOF on an earlier side jumps past the remaining sides' update for that call

Units 201-204 opened in Tide_READ_DATA_INIT are never CLOSEd in this file; TIDE_DATA re-derives Ifile from a local variable @L670 that shadows the module Ifile @L93; comment @L768 mislabels south unit 203 as '! east'

TIDE_BC strips are indexed on the local domain (I=1,Iwidth @L277; I=Mloc-Iwidth+1 @L289; J=1,Iwidth @L300; J=Nloc-Iwidth+1 @L312) with no npx/npy boundary-ownership test, while SPONGE_TIDE_* values encode global position (L230-L256) — interior processors rely on the sponge arrays evaluating to the pass-through value

Tide width parameter is read from input key 'WaveMakerPointNum' @L123 (wavemaker-named key controls tide sponge width); local Lstart,Lend @L219 declared but never used; TideDataFileName @L78 and WaveMaker import @L107 unused in this file; unit 3 (log file) is written throughout but opened elsewhere

Tide_READ_DATA_INIT: when a side's file name key is missing, the warning prints TRIM(TMP_NAME) (L548/L579/L609/L639) which at that point still holds the previous side's file name (or blanks) rather than the missing key name
